page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance driven by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance configures 1 physical core into 2 dedicated vCPUs via hyperthreading, paired with 4.0 GB of RAM to maintain a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware features include 32 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 instruction sets (f, vnni, bf16), and cryptographic hardware acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The instance provides 3 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. It does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators.

Performance data demonstrates strong single-threaded CPU capability alongside modest multi-core capacity. In stress-ng single-core tests, the server scores 3111.68, placing in the top tier (top 10%). Its Geekbench single-core score of 1997.0 falls into the top 25%. However, due to the two-vCPU hardware limit, multi-core benchmark performance remains low, with stress-ng multi-core (3113.59) and Passmark CPU (3870.88) ranking in the bottom 25%. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth averages 47.32 GB/sec, while database operations score in the bottom 10%.

Because of its low core density and focused execution profile, the server offers targeted resource utilization for single-threaded tasks. It fits small microservices, lightweight build scripts, utility background tasks, and low-traffic web serving where high per-core execution speed is required without needing massive parallel thread scaling or large memory capacity.
